mapper.insert: INSERT INTO venue (name, code, type, capacity, price, open_time, close_time, open_time_desc, description, status, cover_image_url, image_urls, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{type}, #{capacity}, #{price}, #{openTime}, #{closeTime}, #{openTimeDesc}, #{description}, #{status}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{imageUrlsJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE venue SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, type = #{type}, capacity = #{capacity}, price = #{price}, open_time = #{openTime}, close_time = #{closeTime}, open_time_desc = #{openTimeDesc}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, image_urls = #{imageUrlsJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.name, v.code, v.type, v.capacity, v.price, v.open_time, v.close_time, v.open_time_desc, v.description, v.status, v.cover_image_url, v.image_urls, v.remark, v.create_time, v.update_time, fp.id AS floor_plan_id, fp.title AS floor_plan_title, i.item_uid AS floor_plan_item_uid, i.label AS floor_plan_item_label FROM venue v LEFT JOIN floor_plan_item i ON i.venue_id = v.id LEFT JOIN floor_plan_item_rel r ON r.floor_plan_item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN floor_plan fp ON fp.id = r.floor_plan_id AND fp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE v.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id, v.name, v.code, v.type, v.capacity, v.price, v.open_time, v.close_time, v.open_time_desc, v.description, v.status, v.cover_image_url, v.image_urls, v.remark, v.create_time, v.update_time, fp.id AS floor_plan_id, fp.title AS floor_plan_title, i.item_uid AS floor_plan_item_uid, i.label AS floor_plan_item_label FROM venue v LEFT JOIN floor_plan_item i ON i.venue_id = v.id LEFT JOIN floor_plan_item_rel r ON r.floor_plan_item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN floor_plan fp ON fp.id = r.floor_plan_id AND fp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE v.code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM venue
AND type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{type}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
